about: An ignored advisory that is no longer detected is denied (-D advisory-not-detected), so a stale ignore fails like a new advisory; recorded from cargo-deny 0.20.2 (2.1-M204)
expect: $ sh -c cargo deny --version && exec cargo deny "$@" 2>&1 sh --format json --manifest-path Cargo.toml --config deny.toml check -D advisory-not-detected
